events.text: I can see the paint. I can't reach the paint.
Look at the moss on this ledge. You can see every strand.
I've never made a jump in my life. Here goes!
Going to do the yellow thing.
If I die, put that in the report.
Made it! Can I go back and look at the scenery?

profile.intro: Brilliant writer, 30 years in the industry. Nobody has ever told him he can't jump.
